description: Completed operations, outstanding commitments, reasons work does not execute, and transaction costs for the selected environment. Counts are observed operations during the selected period, including retries and separate service observations; stages are not a cohort conversion. Missing telemetry remains unknown. Fees are costs, not profit.

spec.title: Decision counts
spec.description: Every parsed auction contributes one bounded terminal decision. Values aggregate all matching services.

spec.title: Decision latency · selected period
spec.description: Combined histogram observations during the selected period. An idle short window does not erase earlier samples in this period. No latency samples means no percentile is available. Initial unobserved counter values cannot be recovered.

spec.title: Observed bid lifecycle stages
spec.description: Independent observations in this period. Wins and settlements can belong to earlier or recovered bids; these counts do not form a cohort conversion.

spec.title: Feed connection history
spec.description: Feed continuity over the selected time range. Values aggregate all matching services.

spec.title: Activity ages
spec.description: Current state-refresh age and ages of the latest bid lifecycle timestamps observed in the interval. Zero timestamps mean Not observed; missing samples stay empty.

spec.title: Winning bids still awaiting settlement
spec.description: Winning reservations still awaiting settlement. Values aggregate all matching services.

spec.title: Unresolved wins and settlement risks
spec.description: Event counts in the selected interval for unresolved wins, breaker failures and failed settlements. deposit_below_floor is a current 0/1 flag, not an event count.

spec.expr: label_replace(sum (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="unresolved"}[$__range])), "signal", "unresolved_win", "", "") or label_replace(sum (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",solver="redstone-oev",event="breaker",outcome="failure"}[$__range])), "signal", "breaker_failure", "", "") or label_replace(sum (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",solver="redstone-oev",event="bid",outcome="settled_failed"}[$__range])), "signal", "failed_settlement", "", "") or label_replace(max (oev_deposit_below_floor{namespace="${namespace}"}), "signal", "deposit_below_floor", "", "")

spec.title: Feeds connected
spec.description: Aggregate feeds connected. Current state uses the latest samples; counters cover the selected time range.

spec.expr: sum(min by (namespace, job, instance) (oev_feed_connected{namespace="${namespace}"})) / count(max by (namespace, job, instance) (solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}",solver="redstone-oev"}))
